'''Detention block 241''' was a [[detention area]] aboard the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']]. [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] and his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] escorts were imprisoned in detention block 241, and escaped when the ship was [[Attack on the Subjugator|attacked]] by [[Task Force Starfall]].<ref name="Starfall" />
